title: Relay Target Bursts
functionSignature: def relay_target_bursts(changes: list[int], target: int) -> int:
statement:
A relay records signed energy changes in arrival order. A burst is a nonempty contiguous span of records. Count how many bursts have total energy change exactly equal to target. Bursts with different start or end positions count separately, even when they contain equal values. Negative changes and zeroes are allowed. An empty log contains no bursts.

For [2, -2, 2] and target 2, the two single-record bursts containing 2 and the whole log qualify, so return 3. Return an integer; do not print the answer.
constraints:
0 <= len(changes) <= 100000
-1000000 <= changes[i] <= 1000000
-1000000 <= target <= 1000000
Aim for O(n) expected time and O(n) space. The count can exceed a signed 32-bit integer.

examples.explanation: Two single-record bursts and the entire log total 2.
